reason: Both sell a cloud HCM platform covering payroll, tax filing and HR to US employers. Paylocity's site describes a unified HCM platform with payroll and tax filing (T:P1.2, T:P1.7). Paycom's site describes cloud HCM software for payroll and HR on a single database (C:P1.2, C:P2.2). Both are subscription software, so offering, customers and business model line up. Paylocity's emphasis on mid-sized employers and its added finance and IT modules do not change the overlap.
